description: This is a shell script (bash/sh) that manages WAN-side SSH access by setting up dropbear SSH server, managing firewall rules, and handling IP configuration for IPv4 and IPv6 on the WAN interface.

methods.name: get_wan_ips
methods.description: Retrieves the current IPv4 and IPv6 addresses of the WAN interface, retries until addresses are available.

methods.name: start_dropbear_wan
methods.description: Starts the dropbear SSH server with appropriate configuration and parameters based on current IP addresses.

methods.name: add_v4firewall_rule
methods.description: Inserts iptables rule to accept incoming SSH traffic on IPv4.

methods.name: add_v6firewall_rule
methods.description: Inserts ip6tables rule to accept incoming SSH traffic on IPv6.

methods.name: remove_v4firewall_rule
methods.description: Removes iptables rule that permits SSH traffic on IPv4.

methods.name: remove_v6firewall_rule
methods.description: Removes ip6tables rule that permits SSH traffic on IPv6.

methods.name: start_wan_ssh_service
methods.description: Main loop to monitor IP addresses and manage the dropbear service and firewall rules accordingly.

methods.name: stop_wan_ssh_service
methods.description: Stops the SSH service and removes associated firewall rules.
